opening.argument: The presentation promotes a Bitcoin-mining opportunity by claiming that a $3,500 position produced roughly 11 Bitcoin, about 1.1 Bitcoin per month. It couples those claimed returns with buying a share, recruiting participants into left and right binary teams, and maintaining monthly qualifications to receive percentage commissions, referral payouts, and daily dividends. Those features establish the promoted scheme: paid participation in mining returns alongside compensation tied to recruitment and purchases. The records do not verify that the mining, payments, or claimed returns occurred, leaving the central earnings claims unsupported.
